# Product and Deployment Documentation Update

Date: 2026-11-17. Task: D1. Status: complete.

## Scope

Established CareerAtlas as a standalone product and development documentation system. Preserved PHP/Laravel, Vue 3/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, five scenarios, 39 features, 27 acceptance criteria, and phase boundaries. Added deployment preparation and verification requirements.

## Verification and delivery

At completion, the documentation validator checked 45 Markdown documents, 44 required files, 127 local links, feature/acceptance coverage, and stage markers. The initial documentation framework was committed as `bddc6ed` with subject `docs: establish initial product and development documentation framework`.

No application implementation or deployment was part of D1.

## Subsequent documentation ownership change

The [documentation separation task](2026-11-17-documentation-separation.md) moved installation-specific decisions and their original record into ignored local documentation. This shared record retains the product outcome; the deployment document now defines portable requirements. The original commit remains historical evidence, not the current documentation ownership policy.
